hooks.command: jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "If you shipped anything this session (bug fix OR feature), run the full Ship sequence from the repo CLAUDE.md before wrapping. Do NOT treat PR-open as the end. (1) State the PR number. (2) Classify every migration or manual SQL this session created against the CLAUDE.md risk gate: SAFE = purely additive (CREATE TABLE, ADD COLUMN, CREATE INDEX, RLS on new tables, backfill of a column added this session); GATED = destructive or irreversible (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE/UPDATE of existing rows, type changes, renames, RLS on existing tables, anything touching profiles/memberships/Stripe). If there is none, say No migration this session. (3) Apply SAFE migrations YOURSELF via the Supabase MCP, print the SQL you applied in a fenced sql block, and verify it took; do not ask Jay to run SAFE SQL. For GATED migrations print the SQL, state the risk in one sentence, and wait for Jay. (4) Merge the PR YOURSELF with gh pr merge once tsc is clean and the migration step is done; only prompt Jay and wait if the session touched payments/Stripe, auth flows, or data-deletion paths, or the migration was GATED. (5) Append an entry to bugs/SHIP-LOG.md (type, pr, branch, ids, migration, status, tsc): status merged with the real PR number when the PR is merged (usually by you), or status pending only if a gated step was deferred; set the migration field; state which BUG-IDs or feature scope shipped. If nothing shipped this session, say so explicitly and skip the SHIP-LOG entry."}'
